info.name: Auth API Tests
info.description:
Postman collection for Auth module test automation. Based on server/testing/auth.md

## Usage
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Import the environment file (auth.postman_environment.json)
3. Select environment "Auth API - Local"
4. Update {{base_url}} if needed
5. Run requests in order or use Collection Runner with auth-test-data.json

## OTP Handling
Requests in "Password Reset Flow" folder set {{otp}} automatically via test endpoint.
If your server doesn't have GET /api/test/otp, manually set {{otp}} from Redis before running confirm-otp.

item.description:
Xóa tất cả test users đã tạo trong session.

Set 2 biến trong environment (Current Value):
- `supabase_project_ref`: Ví dụ `https://xyzabc.supabase.co`
- `service_role_key`: Service role key từ Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API

Chạy request, nó sẽ loop qua từng user ID và gọi DELETE qua Supabase Admin API.

Nếu chưa set 2 biến trên, có thể chạy SQL script thủ công:
```sql
DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE email LIKE 'tenant-%@test.com' OR email LIKE 'ep%@test.com' OR email LIKE 'reset-%@test.com' OR email LIKE 'landlord-%@test.com' OR email LIKE 'bva-%@test.com';
```
